creative_direction: Photograph the underside of one fern leaflet, showing neat gold-brown spore dots following a delicate green vein. Use a broad sage-gray background and preserve the leaf's calm repeating structure. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
